title: Poor overall quality
text: Poor overall quality. At first I thought this canister was great.  However, after about a month the inner plastic gasket fell off and really can't be enticed to stay in place.  Also the plastic cracks very easily; the canister fell over once and the whole thing cracked and a piece fell out!  Find something else.

description: The Home Intuition Air Tight Canister is a must-have in each and every home. This canister comes in a variety of sizes allowing you to store your favorites and items you use every day such as popcorn, cereal, sugar and so much more. Clear acrylic lets you see what's inside. Ideal for organizing your pantry shelf, kitchen counter, bedroom, or even your bathroom for neat and nifty storage.
